summary: Tower on Diamond Peak, Sierra County, NM, in the Gila National Forest; listed gone; no source found describes its history or remains.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no date or cause given

evidence.supports: a tower listed as gone in Sierra County, with coordinates
the peak is in the Gila National Forest

notes_for_editor: Two listings only. The Forest Lookouts Diamond Peak page carries a title and forest name, nothing more. Two searches and the local crawl cache (NHLR, FFLOS, Wikipedia) gave no build, staffing, fire or remains information for this tower. The story runs below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports no more. Search results for Diamond Peak were mostly Washington State lookouts (Kaniksu and Umatilla NF) and were excluded. The brief's record (tower, gone, Gila NF) checks out.
